name: condensate-cahn-hilliard
description: The condensate study flagship: a scalar field phi on a 64x64 fields grid, seeded with near-critical noise (mean 0, uniform +/-0.025 -- the exact np.random.default_rng(0).uniform(-0.025, 0.025, size=(64,64)) draw verified stable/phase-separating in tests/test_cahn_hilliard.py, embedded here as a static array since composite JSON state can't call an RNG at build time), undergoes spinodal decomposition under Cahn-Hilliard dynamics alone (CahnHilliard, pure numpy, no CPM/cobra path at all -- an independent, uncoupled condensate-phase-separation analogue, not a mechanistic model of a specific biomolecular condensate). Each tick runs steps_per_tick=200 explicit CH updates at the pinned-stable M=1.0, kappa=0.5, dt=0.002 (see meta_modelers_guide/condensate/cahn_hilliard.py's stability note); phi_var rises from ~0.0002 (near-flat) toward the coexistence variance as phi separates into +1/-1 domains, while mean(phi) stays conserved near 0 -- verified directly against the module's ch_step over the same seed/params: phi_var reaches ~0.11 by 5000 total steps (tick 25) and ~0.38 by 10000 total steps (tick 50).

provenance.source: task-4 condensate-study flagship build (near-critical noise seed matches tests/test_cahn_hilliard.py's verified _seed_phi(n=64, seed=0))
